title: AWS EKS Masterclass Cape Town
heading: AWS EKS Masterclass: Enterprise EKS at Scale in FinTech
body: Running container platforms in Financial Services introduces a different class of challenges than initial deployment. While Amazon EKS provides a robust and scalable control plane, the complexity of operating it in a regulated environment emerges over time — driven by requirements from security teams, auditors, and regulators, as well as the need to support multiple development teams safely and efficiently.
